“Having done several military moves-and moving in general-a great realtor is VITAL to a smooth transition when looking for a new home. Zach was our eyes and ears on the ground for this home, and never failed to ask us, "What other questions/concerns do you have for me?" we were extremely pleased with his professionalism and care. If you are looking for a realtor that you can trust, shares your concerns and answers all your questions, Zach is the man.”
